summary: Closes the Workbench CI coverage gap recorded in GOAL-WORKBENCH-12 (OWNER-WORKBENCH-CI-COVERAGE-01). The Workbench job now runs the real-worker suites for the private host and study adapter after its release checks, building the pinned C-03 and Julia workers first, and workbench_scope.py selects the job for the host, the adapter, those suites (read from the script that runs them) and itself. The change is additive: the owner-pinned classify_changes.py and development_scope.py are untouched. The owner chose this knowing every Workbench change pays for the images and suites, and the PR records measured before and after job times.
